blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Council for the Welfare of Children (CWC) on Friday called out a comedian over “sexualized humor” involving playground “and their association with children.” Comedian Mr. JP Aguilera of Pencilbox Comedy posted on Facebook: “Sabi ng doktor ko watch what you eat, kaso kumokonti na yung mga playground (My doctor said to watch what you eat, but playgrounds are getting fewer).” READ: Only 1 of 5 ‘Machong Chismisan’ hosts appears at NBI following subpoenas This joke, the CWC said, “uses playgrounds and their association with children as a sexual reference, raising serious concerns about the use of minors as […]...
